description: New symptom descriptions for blinded manual relevance review. No relevant campaign IDs are preassigned. These queries are NOT derived from campaign texts and may legitimately have no matching recall.

cases.query: My windshield wipers sometimes stop and the reverse camera screen goes black.
Engine hesitates and suddenly loses power when I accelerate onto the highway.
The front passenger seat belt buckle will not latch consistently.
Steering wheel shakes when I brake at highway speeds.
The airbag warning indicator stays illuminated after starting the vehicle.
The cabin makes a squeaking noise when I turn on the air conditioning.
Vehicle intermittently stalls at intersections and is difficult to restart.
Brake pedal feels soft and the car takes too long to stop.
Rear camera display freezes when I put the car into reverse.
Dashboard and exterior lights flicker while driving.
Truck unexpectedly shifts out of gear and loses propulsion.
The door seems closed but opens unexpectedly while I am driving.
Brake pedal becomes hard at low speeds and stopping distance increases.
Steering suddenly gets heavy and I have trouble turning the wheel.
My reverse camera intermittently displays a black screen.
The passenger airbag warning light remains on when someone sits in front.
The vehicle loses power unexpectedly while merging onto the freeway.
The Bluetooth audio system disconnects when I play music.
